theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_gd_subspace_lattice_packing
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : ℕ), ∃ S : Finset (Euclid P), S.card = (2 * M + 1) ^ Module.finrank ℝ V ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ V) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ‖x‖ ≤ 2 * M * Real.sqrt (Module.finrank ℝ V)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → 2 ≤ dist x y)
